svg.title: Where a changed value was lost
svg.desc: Three stages for the questions of the experiment, each with two rows: Letta as shipped and Letta with three persona lines. Stage 1, at the user message that carried the new value (64 questions): as shipped, the agent wrote the new value in 31 and did not in 33, of which 18 times its own reply named the new value; with the persona lines, it wrote it in 57 and did not in 7. Stage 2, searches at question time: as shipped, 97 of 146 returned nothing; with the persona lines, 71 of 151. Stage 3, what the answer had to work with (67 questions): as shipped, the block held the value in 36, a search returned it in 17, neither in 13, and one history has no memory; with the persona lines, 59, 4, 3 and 1.
svg.text: Where a changed value was lost
The real Letta server on LongMemEval, one agent step per user message: as shipped, and with three lines added to its
persona. Each stage could have caught what the one before it missed.
1. AT THE MESSAGE THAT CARRIED THE NEW VALUE
did not write it, but named it in its reply
Failure 2: a phrase match, five newest
3. WHAT THE ANSWER HAD TO WORK WITH
Failure 3: a stale block is trusted
The persona lines were written after reading the first run's failures, on the same questions. Stage 1 comes from reading the edit at each message;
in stage 3, one history has no memory at all (the model provider's content filter stopped it).
